correctness.rationale: Summing LG(:,y)=delta_y-1/N over descendant subtrees gives edge increment 1_{y in subtree}-q_l; telescoping along root-to-x and zero row sums yield G(x,y)=t(x,y)+H-F(|x|)-F(|y|). Exact LCA expectation and centering show |R_h(k)-2(1-q1)F(k)|<=2delta_h, where delta_h<=h*b^(h+1)/(b^(h+1)-1)^2. Uniformly in k this yields ||G||_infty/N->2/b with O_b(h) unscaled error; fixed-depth limit is (2/b)(1-b^-k). Separately the leaf sign partition gives exact absolute row formula. Independent rational matrix identity LG=I-11^T/N and leaf response checked b=2,3,h=1..3, and actual check.py read; finite tests only corroborate.
